items.question: How does SığortaPro work?
items.answer: You choose the type of insurance you need and fill in the online application form. Our specialist then contacts you, answers your questions and prepares a personalised offer based on your details.

items.question: Why aren’t exact prices shown on the website?
items.answer: Insurance premiums depend on the individual characteristics of the vehicle, property, trip or insured person. That’s why we provide the exact price in an offer prepared from your details.

items.question: How can I contact you?
items.answer: Call us on 070 609 29 69 or message us on WhatsApp. You can also use the online application form on the website.

items.question: Which types of insurance can I apply for?
items.answer: You can apply for compulsory motor insurance, CASCO, travel, property and life insurance.

items.question: How is my personal information used?
items.answer: We use your details only to review your application and get in touch with you. You can find more information in our Privacy Policy.

InsurancePage.compareDescription: Compulsory insurance and CASCO serve different purposes. Here are the key differences:
compulsoryPoints: Premium calculated according to rules set by legislation
cascoPoints: Terms and price depend on the chosen programme
InsurancePage.compareNote: For broader protection, many drivers choose both.

PricesPage.title: Insurance prices and plans
PricesPage.description: Explore the plan options for each type of insurance. Your exact price is calculated individually from your details — apply to get a quote.

faq.question: How can I get a quote?
faq.answer: Fill in the online application, call us or message us on WhatsApp — our specialist will prepare a personalised offer based on your details.

faq.question: What affects the price?
faq.answer: Depending on the type of insurance: vehicle characteristics, property type and value, trip length and destination, your age, as well as the selected coverage and deductible.

faq.question: Are the plans on the website final?
faq.answer: No. The plans are for guidance only. Exact terms, coverage and price are determined individually and governed by the insurance contract.

faq.question: How is the price of compulsory motor insurance calculated?
faq.answer: The premium for compulsory motor insurance is calculated according to rules set by legislation, taking into account the vehicle type and its technical characteristics.

Legal.intro: The information on this page applies to the use of the SığortaPro website.

privacy.title: General provisions
body: This Privacy Policy explains how personal information you provide while using the SığortaPro website (the “Website”) is collected, used and protected.
By using the Website, you agree to the terms of this policy.

privacy.title: Information we collect
body: Information you provide when completing the application form: full name, phone number, email address (optional) and details related to the chosen insurance type (for example, about a vehicle, trip or property).
Technical information necessary for the Website to function properly (for example, your selected language).

privacy.title: How we use information
body: To review your application and contact you; to prepare a suitable insurance offer; to improve the quality of our service; and to comply with legal requirements.

privacy.title: Sharing of information
body: We do not sell your personal information. It may be shared only when necessary to process your application — with parties involved in providing the insurance service — or where required by law.

privacy.title: Data protection
body: We take appropriate organisational and technical measures to protect your information against unauthorised access, alteration and loss.

privacy.title: Your rights
body: In accordance with the legislation of the Republic of Azerbaijan, you have the right to access your personal information and to request its correction or deletion.

privacy.title: Cookies
body: The Website may use only technical cookies that are necessary for it to function properly. No advertising or tracking cookies are used.

privacy.title: Changes and contact
body: This policy may be updated from time to time; the updated version will be published on this page.
For questions about this Privacy Policy, please call 070 609 29 69.

terms.title: General provisions
body: These Terms and Conditions set out the rules for using the SığortaPro website (the “Website”). By using the Website, you accept these terms.

terms.title: Description of the service
body: The Website lets you find information about insurance products and prepare an online application. Information on the Website is for guidance only and does not constitute a public offer.

terms.title: Prices and terms
body: Plans, coverage and other information shown on the Website are preliminary. Exact insurance terms, coverage and premiums are determined individually and governed by the insurance contract concluded.

terms.title: User obligations
body: To provide accurate and complete information when applying, to use the Website only for lawful purposes and not to interfere with its operation.

terms.title: Intellectual property
body: Texts, design, logo and other materials on the Website belong to SığortaPro and may not be used without permission.

terms.title: Limitation of liability
body: We strive to keep the information on the Website up to date, but we are not liable for consequences arising from technical interruptions or changes in information.

terms.title: Governing law
body: These terms are governed by the legislation of the Republic of Azerbaijan.

terms.title: Changes and contact
body: These terms may be updated from time to time; the updated version will be published on this page.
For any questions, please call 070 609 29 69.
